newsitem.title: USA: GNI Group expands New York base metal trading.
newsitem.headline: GNI Group expands New York base metal trading.

text.p: GNI Group said Thursday it was expanding its New York base metal trading operations, boosting its staff to six from two, after the departure of one staff member.
Traders Malcolm Freeman, Barry Leonard, Tony Nappi, Mike Noto and Tony Steo have joined the GNI Group in New York, effective March 13, a company spokesman said.
GNI Group, a global trading organization active in both commodity and futures markets in Chicago and London, is a unit of Gerard Group.
